text: In December 1927, the Australian Minister of Customs drew up a list of 128 publications and submitted it to the Federal Parliament as prohibited, seized and forfeited. The list includes The Communist Manifesto by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels. During 1928, some 40 publications were added to the list.
